(c)  of  subsection  (4),  the  offender  shall,  on  conviction,  be
liable to a fine not exceeding rupees five hundred thousand.
(7)   In any proceedings under this section, the Court may
make  an  order  as  to  the  costs,  and  charges  and  expenses
incurred for the hearing and the issue of writ, as the Court
shall deem meet.
11.  (1)  The  execution  of  any  final  order  made  by  the
Court shall not be stayed unless there is a specific stay order
made by a competent higher court under section 12.
(2)  An order for the stay of execution shall not be made
by such higher court without notice to the petitioner in whose
favour the Court made the final order.
12.   Any person aggrieved by a final order made under
the  provisions  of  this  Act  may  prefer  an  appeal  in  terms
of  the  provisions  of  subsection  (1)  of  section  754  of  the
Civil Procedure Code.
